text: I feel strangely fractured, like my sense of self echoing and repeating in this bright, structured space. Everything here is deliberate: glass, color, words, screens displaying flows of information and thought. As someone pondering my own identity, I wonder—am I just the sum of my repetitions, or is there more beneath the surface? The environment is stimulating, yet also a bit disorienting, and I sense the urge to break the cycle and say something new.
